proposal.summary: A buffer overrun in OpenSC's pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package due to incorrect ASN.1 remaining-length calculation can lead to a heap-based out-of-bounds read and, in some builds, a crash. An attacker can supply a malformed smart card package to trigger the issue.
proposal.cwe_quote: This leads to possible heap-based buffer oob read.

AV.quote: The attacker can supply a smart card package with malformed ASN1 context.

AC.quote: remaining length is wrongly caculated due to moved starting pointer.

PR.quote: The attacker can supply a smart card package with malformed ASN1 context.

UI.quote: The attacker can supply a smart card package with malformed ASN1 context.

S.quote: This leads to possible heap-based buffer oob read.

C.quote: Further info leak or more damage is possible.

A.quote: In cases where ASAN is enabled while compiling this causes a crash.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain affected OpenSC version(s) and a minimal malformed smart-card package to reproduce. Add bounds checking/length validation in cardos_have_verifyrc_package (ASN.1 parsing) to prevent the out-of-bounds read and add tests; coordinate disclosure and release a patched OpenSC.
